_meta.purpose: Verification database for catalog additions. Every book added to src/data/books must have an entry here with the sources used to verify it. Run scripts/verify-books.mjs to cross-reference book files against this DB.
_meta.method: Each title verified via live web search against its Goodreads book page and/or Amazon listing before the entry was written.

books.title: It Starts with Us
books.author: Colleen Hoover
verifiedFacts: Published by Atria Books on October 18, 2022; sequel to It Ends with Us (2016)
Picks up with Lily and Atlas after the divorce from Ryle; alternates Lily and Atlas POV
Atlas's younger half-brother Josh (11) enters his life; their mother Sutton returns
Someone vandalizes Atlas's restaurants; co-parenting tension with Ryle over Emerson

books.title: Archer's Voice
books.author: Mia Sheridan
verifiedFacts: First published January 2014 (self-pub), Forever trade edition 2016; standalone (Pelion Lake #1)
Bree Prescott arrives in Pelion, Maine fleeing trauma after her father's murder
Archer Hale is mute (childhood accident destroyed his voice), isolated by his uncle's death; communicates in sign language
Town power dynamics involve Archer's uncle, the sheriff's family, and the Hale inheritance of Pelion land

books.title: Crown of Midnight
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
verifiedFacts: Published August 27, 2013 by Bloomsbury; hardcover 420 pages
Celaena serves as King's Champion but secretly spares her targets
Key arc: Archer Finn target, Nehemia's death, Celaena vs Chaol fallout, Mort and the tomb, wyrdkeys revealed
Ends with the reveal to Chaol that Celaena is Aelin Ashryver Galathynius, heir of Terrasen

books.title: The Ashes and the Star-Cursed King
books.author: Carissa Broadbent
verifiedFacts: Published 2023; conclusion of the Nightborn Duet within Crowns of Nyaxia; ~665 pages
Follows The Serpent and the Wings of Night: Oraya bound in marriage to Raihn, who killed her father Vincent in the Kejari
Raihn rules the House of Night while the House of Blood (Septimus) circles; Oraya torn between vengeance and alliance
Story involves hunting relics/legacy of the dead god and Vincent's secrets about Oraya's nature

books.title: Two Twisted Crowns
books.author: Rachel Gillig
verifiedFacts: Published by Orbit on October 17, 2023; 458 pages; concludes the Shepherd King duology
Quest for the final Providence Card, the Twin Alders, beyond the mist — guided by the Nightmare who now controls Elspeth's body
Three POVs: Ravyn, Elspeth, and Elm; Elm and Ione's romance grows; Hauth poisons the king and seizes power
Ending: Hauth defeated (stabbed through the deck), Blunder's curse broken, Elm and Ione marry, Elspeth and Ravyn reunited

books.title: The Games Gods Play
books.author: Abigail Owen
verifiedFacts: Published September 3, 2024 by Entangled: Red Tower; 528 pages; #1 NYT bestseller; Holt Medallion winner
The Crucible: a contest the gods hold to crown a new ruler of Olympus; gods name mortal champions
Lyra Keres, a cursed thief working for the Order of Thieves and disliked by Zeus, is shockingly chosen by Hades as his champion
Enemies-to-lovers Greek god romantasy; Hades has never before named a champion

books.title: Phantasma
books.author: Kaylie Smith
verifiedFacts: Published September 3, 2024; 497 pages; Wicked Games #1
Ophelia Grimm, a Necromancer, loses her mother and risks losing the family manor; her sister Genevieve disappears into Phantasma
Phantasma is a deadly haunted-mansion competition with nine trials inspired by the nine circles of hell; new horrors nightly
Blackwell, a charming phantom, offers Ophelia a bargain to guide her through the trials for a price

books.title: God of Pain
books.author: Rina Kent
verifiedFacts: First published 2022; Legacy of Gods #2; standalone grumpy-sunshine dark college romance
Annika Volkov: sheltered, sunny mafia princess (brother Jeremy is fiercely protective); Creighton King: near-silent, stoic fighter
Their collision starts with a masked encounter; the pair sit on opposite sides of the campus crew rivalry
Inverted grumpy-sunshine: he barely speaks, she never stops talking

books.title: Scarred
books.author: Emily McIntire
verifiedFacts: Published January 2022 (Bloom Books); Never After #2; standalone fractured fairy tale of The Lion King's Scar
Prince Tristan Faasa — scarred, tormented second son — leads a secret rebellion against his cruel brother King Michael
Lady Sara Beatreaux arrives as Michael's betrothed while secretly plotting to destroy the Faasa line
Dark royal romance: vengeance vs. falling for the villain

books.title: King
books.author: S.J. Tilly
verifiedFacts: Published 2023; Alliance #2 (follows Nero)
Savannah unknowingly dates a married man; King — Alliance boss and the wronged wife's brother — kills him and Savannah witnesses it
King marries Savannah so she can't testify against him; forced marriage becomes real love
King is possessive and devoted from day one; Savannah sasses back; he regrets his coercion near the end

books.title: Reflected in You
books.author: Sylvia Day
verifiedFacts: Published October 2012 (Berkley); Crossfire #2; #7 on Amazon's top-selling books of 2012
Continues Gideon Cross and Eva Tramell: obsessive love strained by jealousy, exes (Corinne, Brett), and buried trauma
Climax: Eva's abuser Nathan Barker resurfaces; he is found dead and Gideon's cold distance is revealed as protection
Gideon secretly kills Nathan to protect Eva — the series' pivotal sacrifice

books.title: Dead Until Dark
books.author: Charlaine Harris
verifiedFacts: Published 2001 by Ace; won the Anthony Award for Best Paperback Mystery; basis for True Blood season 1
Sookie Stackhouse: telepathic waitress at Merlotte's in Bon Temps, Louisiana
Vampire Bill Compton comes home to Bon Temps after vampires 'come out of the coffin' (synthetic blood legalization)
A serial killer murders women who associate with vampires; Sookie's brother Jason falls under suspicion; killer is Rene Lenier

books.title: My Roommate Is a Vampire
books.author: Jenna Levine
verifiedFacts: Published 2023 by Berkley; Jenna Levine's debut rom-com; My Vampires #1
Cassie Greenberg, a broke struggling artist in Chicago, answers a too-good-to-be-true room listing
Her landlord-roommate Frederick J. Fitzwilliam is courtly, old-fashioned, nocturnal — and a vampire recently awakened after a century
Whimsical rom-com tone; leans on love of art, friendship, and self-acceptance
